description: BASELINE: binary voting production strategy. Sharpe 9.39 live. Per-regime stability: bull 0.788, crash 0.785, sideways 0.782, rally 0.778. All DD safe.

architectural: factor-block voter grouping (6 correlated voters -> 4 independent blocks; intra-block averaging). Composite +0.13, raw +0.18, but sideways stab -0.003 (block-averaging dilutes opposing-side damping when signals are weak near 50/threshold). All DD safe. Branch-eligible by composite criterion but session caps at 1 experiment.

architectural: 7th cross-asset trend voter (mean ret_long of OTHER symbols, asymmetric tanh contribution). Composite +0.49, raw +0.34, all regimes pass DD. Stability essentially flat (0.7777 vs 0.778) — fails composite keep "no regression" by 0.0003 (within rounding). Strong branch candidate (per-regime: bull -0.004, crash +0.011, sideways -0.005, rally +0.002).
architectural: strong-consensus quorum entry (>=3 voters with conf>=0.70). composite +0.24, raw +0.04, but min_stab -0.003 (rally 0.7747 worst). Opening branch to fix rally stab.
branch step 7 (tighten PEAK_PROFIT_GIVEBACK 0.25->0.22): rally DD 6.085 still breaches 6.0 cap, min_stab 0.776 vs baseline 0.778. Marginal vs step 6.

branch step 8: replaced binary STRONG_QUORUM count with margin-weighted sum (sum of 2*(c-0.5) for c>0.5, threshold 1.5). Composite +0.62, raw +0.52, min_stab +0.0015 (composite keep path). All DDs safe (bull 5.38, crash 5.26, sideways 5.19, rally 5.30). Closes the open branch successfully.

architectural: flip-trend deadzone (|trend_avg|>0.006 required for flips). Composite -1.44, raw 5.99 BELOW 7.19 floor, min_stab 0.768 (-0.013, rally limiter). Crash DD 8.56 BREACH 6.9 cap, sideways DD 6.14 BREACH 5.6 cap. Blocking flips at zero-crossing leaves positions exposed to reversal beyond stop-loss in choppy regimes.

simplification: remove vol_confirm_mult size factor. Composite +0.12, raw +0.18 (good), but min_stab -0.006 (rally 0.7726). Removing the volume-ratio smoothing on size hurt rally stability. Bull/crash stab improved; rally lost a size-dampening channel.

BRANCH SUMMARY (14 steps): EMA-smooth dyn_threshold across bars (architectural common-mode noise dampener). Step 6 peak: asymmetric smoothing (alpha 0.3 on rises, 0.5 on drops) -> composite 5.914 (+0.144), raw 7.896, min_stab 0.7777 (-0.0013 vs baseline 0.779). Tried: alpha sweeps (0.3-0.7), trend-adaptive smoothing, asymmetric directions, vol_ratio smoothing, realized_vol smoothing, slope voter widening, STRONG_WEIGHT tuning, ENTRY_INITIAL_FRAC. Could not push min_stab above 0.7777 without composite collapse. Rally was persistent limiter at 0.776-0.778. Reverted all 14 commits. Insight: dyn_threshold smoothing IS effective (+0.144 composite, +0.005-0.010 stab in bull/crash) but rally is structurally constrained — needs a different mechanism.

architectural simplification: remove strength_scale from sizing. Composite -1.21, raw 6.15 BELOW 7.19. Sharpe excellent across regimes (15.8/11.8/9.7/10.8) and DDs tiny (2.6-4.0%) but min_stab 0.767 (rally -0.012). Removing strength_scale lowers absolute size everywhere -> volatility of returns drops uniformly but flip/exit boundaries become more noise-sensitive in low-position-size regime.

architectural: averaged-signal co-gate at entry (_avg_signal sign aligns with side). composite +0.025, raw +0.046, min_stab -0.0006 (rally 0.7788 limiter). All DDs safe. Branch entry: min_stab essentially flat AND fundamentally new mechanism. Opening branch to fix rally stab regression — likely caused by the hard zero-crossing on _avg_signal. Try replacing with margin threshold or continuous scaling.

branch step 7 (final): _avg_signal as bias to trend_avg gate (architectural fusion of voter signal into trend boundary), bias coef 0.005. Composite +0.150 vs baseline 5.775, raw +0.194, min_stab +0.0030 (rally went from worst to tied-best). Per-regime stab: bull 0.7914 (-0.004), crash 0.7925 (-0.001), sideways 0.7830 (+0.003), rally 0.7825 (+0.002). All DDs safe (5.38/5.06/5.45/5.05). Architectural mechanism: 0.005*tanh(avg_signal) adds a smooth voter-derived bias to trend_avg before zero-crossing check, fusing two signals into one boundary. Common-mode noise cancels in the fusion. Branch path: step 1 (sign-co-gate, branch_open) -> step 2 (margin 0.10, hurt rally) -> step 3 (continuous size scale, hurt rally) -> step 4 (bias 0.003, +0.131 comp but stab -0.0014) -> step 5 (bias 0.006, +0.136 stab -0.0009) -> step 6 (bias 0.012, regression) -> step 7 (bias 0.005, +0.150 stab +0.003) KEEP.

architectural multi-var: 2-bar voter-consistency gate (prior strong-sum>=1.2 required). composite -0.024, raw +0.007, min_stab -0.0092 (rally 0.7733). Bull -0.44 score / -0.001 stab, sideways -0.04/-0.002, rally +0.05 score but -0.009 stab. 2-bar requirement blocks first-bar trend-onset entries esp. in bull; rally stab hurt because filter creates new boundary type at "prior_bar_was_above_1.2".

architectural: exit-pressure confirmation gate (require >=2 sources >=0.4 OR any saturated). raw 7.91 (flat), composite -0.024, min_stab 0.777 (-0.005). Per-regime stab: bull -0.006, crash -0.001, sideways -0.003, rally -0.006. Confirmation gate delays valid exits — extra hold time propagates noise.

architectural: leaky-max peak_pnl state (peak_new=max(0.97*peak_prev, pos_pnl)). raw -0.62, sideways DD 7.14% BREACHES 5.6 cap (decayed peak -> reduced giveback exit pressure -> hold losing positions longer). Bull stab +0.005, crash +0.001, sideways flat, rally -0.002. Decay rate too aggressive for sideways oscillation.

architectural: stop-loss as smooth pressure source (ramp 0.85->1.15 of |STOP|), removing hard binary gate. raw +0.38, composite +0.25, all regime scores up (bull +1.40, crash +0.32, sideways +0.13, rally +0.19). Stab regressed slightly (bull -0.003, crash -0.004, sideways -0.002, rally -0.005). All DDs safe. Opening branch — bull regime score gain >+0.3 satisfies entry criterion 1. Hypothesis to fix stab: add confirmation logic to soft sum-exit, or asymmetric ramp.

BRANCH SUMMARY (15 steps): smooth-stop-loss-pressure architecture. Step 1 entry: removed hard binary stop, replaced with sum-exit pressure ramp -> raw +0.38, composite +0.25, all regime scores up (bull +1.40, crash +0.32, sideways +0.13, rally +0.19), but min_stab -0.005 (rally limiter 0.7779). Steps 2-15 explored: confirmation logic on sum-exit (hurt rally further), tight SL band 0.95-1.05 (composite back), vol-adaptive bands on SL/slope/PP/deadzone (best stab 0.7807 step 6/12, raw 8.43), narrow low-vol SL band 0.02 (no help), hybrid hard+soft stop (lost gains), vol-adaptive cooldown floor (broke low-vol regimes), exit threshold 1.0->1.10 (DD breaches), bias coef 0.005->vol-adaptive (no help), init_frac vol-adaptive (rally worse), strict flip in low vol (rally worse). Best branch state: raw 8.43 / composite 6.32 / min_stab 0.780 (-0.002 vs orig 0.782) — converged but persistently 0.002-0.003 short on rally stab. Rally is structurally pinned at ~0.778. Reverted all branch commits. Insight: smooth-stop-loss IS a strong composite mechanism (+0.38 raw, +0.25 composite consistently) but rally regime resists noise-band absorption — different mechanism needed for rally stab specifically.

multi-var architectural: differential strong-sum gate (bull_strong - bear_strong > 1.5 replacing MIN_VOTES + STRONG_WEIGHT_MIN). composite -1.68, raw 5.66 BELOW 7.19, sideways DD 6.66 BREACHES 5.6 cap. Differential lets opposite weak voters cancel strong sum, allowing entry on noisy bars. min_stab 0.777 (-0.006). Architectural failure: removing absolute strength gate broke sideways DD discipline.

architectural: slope-modulated peak-profit pressure (pp *= 0.5 + slope_pressure). composite -0.01 flat, raw 7.01 BELOW 7.19, min_stab +0.008 (bull 0.805 +0.014, crash 0.800 +0.008, sideways 0.790 +0.007, rally 0.793 +0.011 — ALL regimes improved). Sideways DD 7.30 BREACHES 5.6 cap (PP relaxes when slope calm -> holds through reversal). Branch entry: large stab gain across all regimes meets criterion 1+2; regression localized to sideways DD with identifiable cause. Hypothesis to fix: add slope-independent floor on pp_pressure to preserve sideways DD discipline.

branch step 2: floor multiplier at 0.85. composite -0.18, raw 7.50 ABOVE 7.19, min_stab +0.001 vs baseline 0.782. All DDs safe (sideways 5.28 fixed). Crash score dropped 6.72->5.58 (likely fewer trades despite sharpe up). Stab improvements preserved (bull 0.803 crash 0.800 sideways 0.785 rally 0.783).

MANUAL KEEP (cross-exchange validated): smooth stop-loss as pressure source + vol-adaptive PP band. Mean Sharpe 9.85 across CC/HL/BN (baseline 9.55), HL Sharpe 9.82 (+0.51), PF 25.01 (+65%), Sharpe spread 0.080. Stab 0.781 vs 0.782 (-0.001) — noise test regression trivial vs massive cross-exchange gain.

architectural: margin-weighted _avg_signal at trend bias gate (|tanh(s)|-weighted mean replacing flat mean). composite -0.03, raw -0.001 flat, min_stab -0.002 (rally 0.7787 worst). All 4 regime stab dropped 0.001-0.004. Margin-weighting concentrates the signal on strong voters, but strong voters still flip in noise — concentration amplifies the flip rather than cancelling it.

architectural: continuous strong-sum entry ramp (1.0-2.0 -> 0-1 scale on size). Replaces binary STRONG_WEIGHT_MIN=1.5 gate with smooth ramp. composite +0.020, raw +0.030, crash stab +0.003, sideways -0.002, rally -0.001 (still limiter at 0.7796). Branch entry: crash stab +0.003 meets criterion 2; structural simplification (boundary removed). Hypothesis: floor the ramp at 1.2 to prevent weak entries that hurt rally stab.

branch step 2: floor strong-sum ramp at 1.2 (block weakest entries). composite flat vs orig baseline, raw +0.019, min_stab 0.7774 — WORSE than step 1's 0.7796. Bull stab +0.003 but rally -0.003. Floor theory wrong: blocking weak entries reduces sample count, hurting rally noise robustness more than helping. No progress vs step 1.

branch step 3: ramp [1.0,2.0] + vol-adaptive entry frac mult (0.85+0.15*min(1,vr)). composite -0.020 vs orig, raw -0.020, min_stab 0.7756 (rally WORSE 0.7756). Vol-adaptive entry shrink hurt rally further — smaller absolute positions mean exits/flips trigger more often relative to position lifetime, amplifying boundary noise rather than damping it.

branch step 4: extend continuous ramp to flip mechanism. composite -0.27, raw -0.38 (BELOW 8.43 baseline), but min_stab 0.7807 (matches orig baseline) — bull stab +0.009. Rally stab back to 0.7807. Continuous flip ramp let weak flips through, hurting returns more than helping stab. Direction is right but execution needs tuning.

branch step 5: flip ramp floor 1.4. composite 6.13 (still below 6.32 baseline), raw 8.16 (below 8.43), min_stab 0.7793 (rally limiter -0.001 vs orig). Floor 1.4 is closer but flip ramp continues to suppress flip strength too much vs binary 1.5 — returns net loss.

branch step 6: revert flip ramp + vol-adaptive deadzone (wider in low-vol). composite +0.007 vs orig, raw +0.028, min_stab 0.7777 (rally WORSE -0.003 vs orig). Wider deadzone in low-vol allowed more vote-only entries near boundary, hurting rally stab. Step 1 was already the local optimum.

branch step 7: narrow deadzone in low-vol. composite +0.009 vs orig, raw +0.031, min_stab 0.7755 (rally WORSE 0.7755). Both deadzone directions hurt rally — boundary shape itself is not the issue. Other regimes (bull crash) improve in stab; rally is structurally pinned.

branch step 8: persistence-gated entry (2-bar min strong-sum). composite -0.033, raw -0.011, min_stab 0.7742 (rally worse 0.7742). Persistence delays entries; missed momentum reduces sample count, amplifying noise. Counter to hypothesis.

branch step 9: deadband on _avg_signal bias |avg|>0.3. composite +0.005 vs orig, raw +0.036, min_stab 0.7734 (rally WORSE 0.7734). Deadband on bias didn't help — rally noise pattern is not in the bias term.

branch step 10: vol-adaptive stop-loss center (1.0+0.25*low_vol mult on |STOP|). composite +0.103 vs orig, raw +0.171 (best in branch), min_stab 0.7770 (PROGRESS +0.004 vs step 9). All regime scores up. Rally stab still -0.003 vs orig baseline 0.781 but trend is positive.

branch step 11: deepen vol-adaptive stop mult 0.40. composite +0.142 vs orig, raw +0.217, min_stab 0.7782 (PROGRESS +0.001 vs step 10). Rally stab nearly recovered to baseline 0.7805 (was 0.7770 step 10). NEW LIMITER: sideways 0.7782 (-0.008 vs orig 0.7857). Sideways needs the deeper stop less than rally — overshoot.

branch step 12: trend-gated deep stop. composite +0.061 vs orig, raw +0.110, min_stab 0.7731 (rally limiter back). Trend gating misfired — rally has lower |ret_long| variance than expected; the trend factor saturated low, removing the rally protection.

branch step 13: deep stop + sideways PP tightening. composite +0.139 vs orig, raw +0.224, min_stab 0.7769 (PROGRESS +0.004 vs step 12). Rally regressed -0.004 vs step 11, sideways improved +0.003. Both fix-attempts trade across regimes.

branch step 14: gentler PP tightening (8 percent). composite +0.124, raw +0.199, min_stab 0.7777 (rally limiter, marginal +0.001 vs step 13). Crash stab regressed slightly. Tweaking PP doesn't substantially shift rally.

branch step 15: revert PP tightening + stop mult 0.30. composite +0.109, raw +0.186, min_stab 0.7759 (rally limiter). 0.30 mult shows no improvement vs 0.40 — sideways doesn't recover when reverting PP. The tradeoff is structurally constrained.

branch step 16: deep stop (0.40) + vol-adaptive dyn_thresh floor (1+0.20*low_vol). composite +0.044, raw +0.081, min_stab 0.7795 (PROGRESS +0.004 vs step 15). Rally stab 0.7795 (close to baseline 0.7807). Floor widening helps stab but suppresses sideways score. Approaching keep target.

branch step 17: dyn_thresh floor mult 0.30. composite -0.020 vs orig, raw -0.013 (back near baseline), min_stab 0.7790 (no progress vs step 16). Sideways stab improved but rally score collapsed (5.21). 0.30 too aggressive.

branch step 18: dyn_thresh floor 0.25. composite +0.029 vs orig, raw +0.083, min_stab 0.7765 (rally limiter). Below step 16 best (0.7795). The architecture has a 0.778 stab ceiling around rally regardless of dyn_thresh tuning.

BRANCH SUMMARY (18 steps): continuous strong-sum entry ramp [1.0, 2.0] -> [0,1] (architectural removal of binary 1.5 entry gate). Step 1 entry: composite +0.020, raw +0.030, crash stab +0.003 — branch_open. Iterations explored: floor variants (1.2, 1.4), vol-adaptive entry frac, flip-ramp extension, persistence-gating (2-bar min), bias deadband, vol-adaptive stop-loss center (mult 0.25/0.30/0.40), trend-gated stop, sideways-PP tightening, vol-adaptive dyn_thresh floor (0.20/0.25/0.30). Best states: step 11 (composite +0.142 raw +0.217 min_stab 0.7782), step 16 (composite +0.044 raw +0.081 min_stab 0.7795 — closest to keep). Min_stab pinned at 0.778-0.780 ceiling — could not push above 0.781 baseline. Composite gain from deep-stop architecture is large (+0.10 to +0.15) but each variant trades stab between rally and sideways. Reverted all 18 commits. Insight: vol-adaptive deep-stop is a powerful composite mechanism but rally/sideways stab tradeoff is structurally bound — needs a different mechanism that breaks this tradeoff (e.g., per-symbol stop or different anchor).

architectural: EMA-smoothed pos_pnl (alpha=0.6) as common input to all exit pressure sources (peak_pnl tracker, stop-loss _loss, giveback). Single-point noise damping across exit subsystem. raw 6.97 BELOW 7.19 floor. min_stab +0.001 (bull stab +0.025, crash +0.018, rally +0.002 — strong stab signal). Sideways DD 7.84% BREACHES 5.6 cap: smoothing delays peak detection in choppy regime so giveback fires after damage done. Bull score +3.3 (smoothed exits hold winners longer in trending). Stab gains real but hard DD cap unfixable without sideways-specific carve-out (which prior 18-step branch showed is structurally bound).

architectural: median-of-3 slope (windows 12/16/22) for exit pressure subsystem replacing shared _lr.slope. Decouples entry/exit slope noise + robust median aggregation. composite +0.32, raw -0.28 (8.15 above 7.19 floor), min_stab -0.0006 (rally 0.7804 limiter, others all up: crash +0.012, sideways +0.005, bull +0.001). All DDs safe (4.39/5.77/4.62/4.95 — best DD profile in months). Branch entry: crash stab +0.012 strongly meets criterion 2; mechanism fundamentally new. Hypothesis to fix rally: 12-bar window noisier in low-vol; try widening to 16/22/28 or vol-adaptive window selection.

branch step 4 (final): mean-of-3 slope consensus (windows 12/16/22) for exit pressure subsystem replacing single _lr.slope. Architectural decoupling of entry/exit slope noise + multi-window averaging. composite +0.46 vs baseline 6.32 (composite keep path), raw 8.39 (-0.04, above 7.19 floor), min_stab 0.7816 vs 0.7807 (+0.0009, no regression). Per-regime stab: bull 0.792 (+0.003), crash 0.803 (+0.014!), sideways 0.792 (+0.006), rally 0.7816 (+0.001) — ALL regimes improved. All DDs safe (4.89/5.23/4.70/5.40 — best DD profile). Branch path: step 1 (median 12/16/22, branch_open at min_stab -0.0006) -> step 2 (median 16/22/28, regressed) -> step 3 (vol-adaptive windows, regressed further) -> step 4 (mean instead of median, KEEP). Insight: median is too sensitive to single-window flips when all slopes are near zero (low-vol); mean spreads the contribution and is the more noise-robust aggregator for exit slope.

architectural: mean-of-3 slope (12/16/22) for ENTRY voter (parallel to exit consensus). composite -0.05, raw -0.04, min_stab 0.778 (-0.004). Bull +0.005 stab and crash +0.002, but sideways -0.006 and rally -0.004. Insight: mean-of-3 consensus helps trending regimes (bull/crash) but hurts low-vol regimes at entry — opposite of exit subsystem profile. Entry decision-making at the slope-voter boundary is more sensitive to window-noise dilution than exit pressure aggregation.

architectural: per-voter noise-sensitivity weights on strong-sum (weights 0.7/1.2/1.1/1.0/0.9/1.1 by voter type, sum=6.0). composite +0.005, raw +0.02, min_stab +0.002 vs baseline 0.7816. Rally stab 0.7837 (+0.002, no longer limiter), bull 0.7926 (+0.001), crash 0.801 (-0.002), sideways 0.787 (-0.005). All DDs safe. Branch entry: rally regime stab improvement +0.002 meets criterion 2; fundamentally new aggregation mechanism. Hypothesis to fix sideways: sideways relies on RSI/EMA voters but those got UPweighted — need to rebalance so sideways-relevant voters keep their effective contribution. Try lowering RSI/EMA weights slightly or up-weight ret_short.

branch step 2: gentler voter weights (0.85/1.10/1.00/1.00/0.95/1.10). composite -0.03 vs step 1, raw -0.03, min_stab 0.7814 (sideways 0.7863 +0.001, but rally 0.7814 lost -0.002 vs step 1). Limiter swapped back to rally. Gentler spread weakens rally protection without freeing sideways enough. Step 1 weights were closer to optimal.

branch step 3: weights (0.85/1.20/1.10/0.95/0.85/1.05). composite 6.77, min_stab 0.7804 (rally 0.7804 limiter). Bull stab +0.006, crash +0.002, but rally -0.001 and sideways -0.004 vs step 1. Up-weighting ret_short helped sideways slightly but down-weighting slope hurt rally further. Step 1 still local opt.

branch step 4: step 1 weights + RSI band 47/53. composite 6.78, min_stab 0.7787 (rally 0.7787 limiter, -0.005 vs step 1). Sideways stab +0.002 (good direction) but rally regressed. Wider mean-rev RSI band reduces rally entries that were stab-positive. Tradeoff: tightening mean-rev hurts rally more than it helps sideways.

branch step 5: trend-modulated weights (interp by rsi_trend_str). composite 6.78, min_stab 0.7803 (rally limiter). Sideways stab 0.7894 (+0.002 vs step 1) — confirmed mechanism: flat weights help sideways. But rally lost -0.003 because moderate rsi_trend_str pulls rally toward flat too. Need rally-specific protection.

branch step 6: sharper trend-blend (decay 0.05). composite 6.77, min_stab 0.7791 (rally still limiter). Slight degrade vs step 5 0.7803. Sharper saturation made rally fully trend-mode but rally noise pattern not actually improved by step 1 weights — rally noise needs different mechanism.

branch step 7: step1 weights + hard-zero conf<0.55. composite 6.79, min_stab 0.7765 (rally limiter, big -0.007 regression). Sideways +0.003 (good) but rally lost. Hard-zero excludes weak rally voters that were stab-positive contributions.

branch step 8: step1 weights + sideways-tightened strong-sum threshold (1.5 + 0.20*(1-rsi_trend_str)). composite -0.01, raw -0.03, min_stab 0.7843 (BEST in branch, +0.0027 vs orig baseline 0.7816 — just below +0.003 keep). Per-regime: bull +0.007, crash +0.005, sideways +0.001, rally +0.003. All DDs safe. Progress vs step 7 — counter resets.

branch step 9: stronger tightening (0.30). composite -0.10 vs step 8, raw -0.11, min_stab 0.7837 (regress vs step 8 0.7843). Sideways stab +0.002 but score loss too steep. 0.30 over-tightens — fewer sideways entries reduces sample → return loss > stab gain.
branch step 10: tightening 0.25. min_stab 0.7827 (-0.002 vs step 8 0.7843). Sideways +0.0023 better than step 8 but rally -0.002. No improvement vs step 8.

branch step 11: step 8 + sideways-scaled bias coef. min_stab 0.7818 (-0.0025 vs step 8 0.7843). Sideways stab held but bull/crash/rally regressed. Bias coef scaling reaches into trends via bull/crash and hurts those.
branch step 12: step 8 + MIN_VOTES tightening +0.15. min_stab 0.7837 (-0.0006 vs step 8). Stacking does not stack — both gates target same noisy entries, marginal diminishing returns.

branch step 13: step 8 + flip-asymmetric tightening (0.30 flip). composite -0.10 vs step 8, min_stab 0.7824 (-0.002 vs step 8). Tighter flips reduce protective reverses, sideways/rally scores drop. Counter to hypothesis.

branch step 14 (final): per-voter noise-sensitivity weights (0.70/1.25/1.10/1.00/0.85/1.10) + sideways-tightened strong-sum threshold (1.5 + 0.20*(1-rsi_trend_str)). Architectural: trend-modulated voter aggregation with continuous noise-sensitivity weighting. composite -0.02 vs baseline 6.78 (within tolerance), raw 8.35 vs 8.39 (-0.04, ABOVE 7.19 floor), min_stab 0.7851 vs 0.7816 (+0.0035, MEETS keep). Per-regime stab: bull 0.7996 (+0.008), crash 0.8020 (-0.001), sideways 0.7876 (-0.004), rally 0.7851 (+0.003 — major rally improvement!). All DDs safe (4.89/5.26/4.65/5.32). Branch path: step 1 (per-voter weights only, +0.002) -> step 8 (added sideways-tight thresh, +0.0027) -> step 14 (refined weights 0.70/1.25/1.10/1.00/0.85/1.10, +0.0035 KEEP). Mechanism: smoothed voters (EMA, RSI) up-weighted, raw price-derivative voters (ret_short, slope) down-weighted, with continuous sideways threshold tightening to compensate for sideways flatness loss. Closes the branch successfully.

architectural state-based: cross-asset consensus gate on entry threshold (+0.30 if symbols net-strong sign disagrees with prev-bar cross-asset avg net-strong, gated by |cross|>0.5). composite -0.58, raw 8.22 ABOVE 7.19, min_stab 0.7809 (-0.0042). All regime stab regressed (bull -0.003, crash -0.003, sideways -0.001, rally -0.004). Cross-asset gate adds new boundary noise at the disagreement-magnitude threshold; the prev-bar state coupling injects extra noise channels rather than denoising. All regimes hurt; rally most.

architectural: per-voter EMA-smoothed confidences (alpha=0.6, span~2.3) at voter level. composite COLLAPSED to 1.26 (-5.50), raw 1.64 BELOW 7.19, all DDs breached (bull 9.85/crash 14.51/sideways 12.41/rally 15.95). min_stab 0.738 (-0.047). EMA smoothing on voter conf added lag that delayed entries AND exits — positions held into reversals far past stop bands. Voter-level low-pass filter is the wrong abstraction layer; the boundary-noise problem lives in aggregation gates, not in raw conf signals.

architectural: voter-coherence size modulator (1.10 - 0.875*min(std/0.40, 1.0)). composite -4.33, raw 2.82 BELOW 7.19, DD BREACHES on crash 10.09 and rally 10.78. min_stab +0.002 (sideways limiter); stab on bull +0.027 and crash +0.017 (signal works as intended). But size reduction too aggressive — returns collapsed across all regimes. Mechanism is sound but coefficients destroy returns; would need much gentler scale (e.g., 0.95 - 0.10*disp) to be viable.

architectural: voter-coherence gate on strong-sum (mult 0.85-1.05 range based on conf std/0.30). composite -0.60, raw 8.17 ABOVE 7.19, min_stab 0.7853 essentially flat (+0.0002). Rally stab +0.0035 (would be branch-eligible) but other 3 regimes regressed -0.002 to -0.004. Composite drop driven by score loss across ALL regimes (bull -0.51, crash -0.37, sideways -0.21, rally -0.09) — coherence damping reduces effective entry signal too broadly. Mechanism trades stab among regimes without net gain in min_stab.

multi-var architectural: slope-aligned dynamic voter weighting (+/-15% scaled by slope_strength). composite -0.45, raw 8.39 ABOVE 7.19, min_stab 0.7827 (-0.0024). Per-regime: bull stab -0.005, crash -0.003, sideways +0.002, rally -0.003. Bull/crash scores -0.47/-0.37, sideways/rally +0.03/+0.12. Slope-alignment HURTS bull/crash where the strong-sum was already optimized for trending; the dynamic re-weighting moves weight away from previously up-weighted MACD/RSI in favor of slope-aligned ret_short which is the noisiest voter.

architectural: sigmoid strong-sum (1/(1+exp(-25*(c-0.85)))) replacing quintic (c-0.5)^5*97.66. composite -0.60, raw 8.02 ABOVE 7.19, min_stab 0.7792 (-0.006). Bull stab +0.001 only; crash/sideways/rally all regressed -0.005 to -0.006. Sigmoid with center 0.85 / sharpness 25 has different scale at threshold than quintic — same _strong_min=1.5 fires on different conf distribution, shifting regime-level entry rates. Bull score balloons (+5.5) while sideways/rally score drops because trending signals saturate sooner.
